$meta.source: Distilled from ../refboards/REFERENCE_DISTILLATION.md (16 boards in sv/refer/) + existing sv.pen warm-industrial direction
$meta.rule: Exactly one saturated accent. Never two accents competing.

ink.note: Near-black. Dark bands, display type on light.

ink-2.note: Elevated dark surface inside dark bands.

ink-3.note: Dark-band hairlines and inactive dark cards.

steel.note: Secondary structural dark, inherited from v1. Corporate/technical panels.

concrete.note: Primary light page field. Warm, not clinical white.

white.note: Card surfaces on concrete. Never pure #FFF.

copper.note: THE accent. Molten-metal orange — earns its place via the ladle/foundry niche.

hairline.note: The grid IS the decoration. 1px only.

watermark-light.note: Oversized ghost headline on light bands.

mono.note: Specs, capacities, part numbers, slide counters. Slashed zero.

micro-caps.use: ALL secondary metadata: labels, dates, categories, counters, captions, eyebrows

rules: Size jump between display and body is 3-4x. No mid-tier headings that blur the hierarchy.
No serifs anywhere. The v1 Cormorant Garamond is retired — it reads editorial-luxury, not heavy-engineering.
micro-caps is the single style carrying every piece of secondary information site-wide.
Numerals in specs and counters are mono with slashed zero.

band-y.note: Vertical padding of a full-bleed section band.

radius.note: Hard-edged by default. Industrial references use 0-4px. Radii above 8px are banned; they read consumer-SaaS.

flat.note: Default. Depth comes from band colour changes and layering, not shadows.

float.note: Floating white page container over a darkened photo only.

rules: Motion vocabulary is minimal and edge-anchored: right-rail dot pagination, 01-03 counters, triple-chevron next, circular scroll button, dashed connector lines.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable reveals and counters, keep final states.
No parallax on the product cut-out. It must stay crisp and readable.

button-primary.note: Small, flat, understated against the huge headline.

button-dark-pill.note: Reserved for the single hero CTA and 'CONTACT arrow' affordance.

card-product.anatomy: micro-caps index (01) + uppercase 1-2 line title top -> cut-out render center, overflowing the card edge -> body-s description -> hairline -> bottom-pinned ghost button or spec row
card-product.hover: ENTIRE CARD fills accent.copper, text inverts to on-accent. Not just the button.

stat-lockup.anatomy: stat-numeral + micro-caps caption stacked to its right

index-row.note: Numbered accordion. Replaces icon bullets entirely.

band.note: Full-bleed colour band is THE section separator. No decorative dividers.

trust-strip.content: ISO 9001 (linked PDF) | IS 807/3177 | GST | MSME | years | installs

nav-grid.note: Header split into cells by 1px hairlines; right-most cell solid accent.copper holding the quote CTA.

rules: Product-in-use over product-in-void: cranes lifting real loads in real bays.
Hero/card products are background-free cut-outs that overflow their container edge.
Cut-out occludes the ghost watermark headline. That overlap is the depth mechanism.
Cinematic factory shooting: wide, well-lit welding / assembly / load-test frames.
Every image alt text carries capacity, span and industry. Alt text doubles as SEO.
Isometric technical line-art for schematic explanation; 3D renders for products; photography for proof.

treatment.duotone-note: Optional ink+copper duotone for archival/low-quality client photos.

rules: Ghost watermark type is decorative and must never carry unique information.
Accent copper on concrete passes for large display only; body copy in copper is banned.
All accordions, filters and tabs need aria-expanded / aria-pressed / aria-controls.
All data tables need scope on headers and a caption.
